title.narrative: UNICEF in partnership with the National Economic and Social Development Board (NESDB) finalized the National Social Protection strategy ensuring it is both child-sensitive and shock-responsive. UNICEF in collaboration with NESDB and the Ministry of Social Affairs (MoSA) trained 52 officers from Social Protection Ministries and 11 Municipalities through TRANSFORM initiative to support key social protection reforms including the establishment of the Unified Social Registry.
